# implement-spec ledger — P0.14 benchmark arms + wave runner

- **spec:** docs/tickets/15_P0.14__benchmark-arms-and-wave-runner.md (+ spec §18.2–18.5, REQ-EVAL-6…11,15,16,17,18,20)
- **base branch:** stevevitali/p0-13-benchmark-enclave-scorers
- **base commit:** 3c972e23da4c7757b91c008864a45a0615db4ce4
- **branch:** stevevitali/p0-14-benchmark-arms-wave-runner
- **baseline:** benchmark 67 tests green @ base

## Design
New package `@rhema/benchmark-runner` (orchestration layer; deps: @rhema/benchmark scorers + @rhema/contracts + @rhema/db).
P0.13 owns schemas+scoring — this package must NOT re-implement scoring; it drives the P0.13 scorers.
Migration `0014_benchmark_runner.sql` (additive; grants to existing `rhema_benchmark` role; role list unchanged).
Seams DI'd: `ArmExecutor` (A4/A5 live engine binding is P0.15), `JudgeModel` (LLM judge call), `BenchmarkDeps` (ids+clock).

Files:
- types.ts — ArmFamily, ArmConfig, RawArmOutput, ArmExecutor, JudgeModel seams
- arms.ts — A1–A6 configs, configHash, re-steelman per wave, persist arm configs
- normalization.ts — de-branding, blind extractor, verbatim-substance, 10% audit (AC2)
- matching.ts — blind matching tasks, human match records, automated suggester (suggest-only)
- adjudication.ts — novelty confirmation, senior adjudication, pairwise preference (both orders)
- judges.ts — cross-family (C-d), position-swap+tie (C-a), calibration κ≥0.6 gate, C-a…C-g report-blocking checks (AC3)
- preregistration.ts — freeze+hash-commit, deviation log, drift detection (AC4)
- wave-runner.ts — orchestrate arms over manifest, drive scoring+adjudication
- report.ts — 12 REQ-EVAL-11 metrics, LIFT (REQ-EVAL-15), stability bands, public/private split (REQ-EVAL-18), consequence log (REQ-EVAL-16), headline-no-pairwise guard (AC5)

## Requirements (spec §18.2–18.5)
- REQ-EVAL-6: six arms; Rhema arms run production engine, pinned protocol@version, no eval-only tuning
- REQ-EVAL-7: normalization — de-brand, blind extractor, verbatim-substance, 10% fidelity audit
- REQ-EVAL-8: human matching/adjudication blind to arm; automated matchers suggest only
- REQ-EVAL-9: LLM judges secondary only; cross-family; position-swap disagreement=tie; anchored rubrics; per-unit+length; per-wave κ≥0.6 calibration gate; C-a…C-g report-blocking
- REQ-EVAL-10: pre-registration freeze+hash-commit; deviation log; dev set exempt
- REQ-EVAL-11: twelve metrics; headline reference-based never pairwise
- REQ-EVAL-15: LIFT readout (Full over A1 ≥15pp recall, invalid≤A1, 2 waves; ≥60% pairwise; voice not worse)
- REQ-EVAL-16: consequence log (go/no-go)
- REQ-EVAL-17: cadence hooks (pilot/wave1/quarterly/frontier-trigger)
- REQ-EVAL-18: report public/private split enforced by generator
- REQ-EVAL-20: Rhema arm runs record engine build + protocol@version + config hash, joinable to run-ledger

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] AC1 end-to-end dry run on dev set: six arms executable (A6 via intake), normalized, matching exercised, twelve metrics, report renders w/ public/private split
- [ ] AC2 blind-normalization: extractor gets de-branded input; branded fixture rejected
- [ ] AC3 judge gates: κ<0.6 disqualified + metrics withheld; position-consistency reported; same-family judge/arm rejected (C-a…C-d)
- [ ] AC4 pre-registration: scored-wave run w/o matching hash-commit refuses report; post-freeze config drift logged as deviation
- [ ] AC5 headline path contains no pairwise metric
- [ ] AC6 Rhema arm runs record engine build + protocol@version + config hash, joinable to metering rows (REQ-EVAL-20/14)

## Out of scope (do NOT do)
- Scorer implementations (P0.13). Corpus/editor/steelman contracting (human). Running pilot wave (P0.15) + wave 1. Marketing surface (REQ-EVAL-19 elsewhere).

## Cross-cutting invariants
- Rhema arms run production engine/protocol as shipped — no eval-only tuning/forks (REQ-EVAL-6)
- No superiority claim except from criterion-meeting pre-registered wave (REQ-EVAL-19)

## Test matrix (1.4)
- arms.test: config-hash determinism (key-order independent); Rhema arm requires engine build+protocol+family (throws); re-steelman; loadArmConfigs → AC6
- normalization.test: deBrand strips tokens; assertDeBranded throws branded (AC2); verbatim-substance violations; normalizeArmOutput persists; sampleForAudit ~10%; extractionFidelity
- matching.test: createMatchTask suggest-only (verdict null); recordMatchDecision matched-requires-gold; loadMatchRecords decided-only; defaultMatcher suggests
- adjudication.test: confirmNovelty only on valid_but_missed_by_gold; pairwise both-orders resolve; disagreement=tie; positionConsistency (C-a)
- judges.test: assertCrossFamily rejects same-family (C-d/AC3); calibrateJudge κ<0.6 disqualified + per-stratum (C-c/AC3); recordJudgeScore rejects headline metric (AC5); qualifiedJudgeScores withholds disqualified (AC3); assertAnchoredRubric (C-g)
- preregistration.test: freeze+hash mirrors to wave; assertPreregistered throws scored-w/o-hash (AC4); dev-set exempt; detectDrift logs config drift (AC4)
- report.test: assertHeadlineNoPairwise (AC5); assertPublicClean leak guard (REQ-EVAL-18); band; classifyConsequence outcomes (REQ-EVAL-16); computeLift
- cadence.test: frontier deadline+30d; escalate on gap-halve; quarterly (REQ-EVAL-17)
- wave-runner.test (INTEGRATION/AC1): dry run on dev set — six arms (A6 intake), normalized, matching exercised, twelve metrics, report renders public/private split; Rhema arm records engine+protocol+config-hash joinable to usage_records (AC6)

## Independent review dispositions (fresh-context subagent)
- MAJOR-1 dev-set/pilot report unlabeled → FIXED: `preliminary`/`devSet` flags + `lift.preliminary` for non-scored waves (AC1 test asserts).
- MAJOR-2 C-e declared not executed → FIXED: `checks.ts` C-e runs `styleControl`, binding when observations supplied (checks.test).
- MINOR-3 LIFT voice used voice+meaning → FIXED: separate `voiceConformanceMean` for the REQ-EVAL-15 guard rail.
- MINOR-4 voice/meaning from opaque extras → ACCEPTED: the extras ARE the measured outputs (voice via @rhema/measure, meaning via claim inventories); the deterministic voice/meaningDiff scorers run in the P0.15/measure integration (D-P0.14-1/3).
- MINOR-5 LIFT = diff of means not paired → FIXED: paired per-draft recall delta over shared drafts (REQ-EVAL-5).
- MINOR-6 gate keyed modelFamily as provider → FIXED: distinct `provider` field; gate uses `provider ?? modelFamily`.
- MINOR-7 judge withholding dead in report → FIXED: `qualifiedJudgeScores` surfaced as `judgeSecondaryMetrics` (AC1 test).
- MINOR-8 no drift detection at render → FIXED: `generateWaveReport` calls `detectDrift` for scored waves (preregistration.test).
- NIT-9 AC5 guard tautological → FIXED: guard now scans assembled per-arm headline keys.
- NIT-10 range band not CI → ACCEPTED: honest low/high range; bootstrap CI is a publication-wave concern.
- NIT-11 mixed now()/clock → FIXED: injected clock threaded through all inserts (deterministic).
- NIT-12 verbatim contiguous-substring strict → ACCEPTED: deliberate safe-side bias for "never sharpen".
